items: Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water; bring to a boil. Cook for 20-30 minutes or until tender; drain and cool slightly.
Slice potatoes into a large bowl.
In a small bowl, combine the mayonnaise, sour cream, yogurt, onions, pickles, mustard, horseradish, garlic and seasonings.
Pour over potatoes and toss to coat.

notes.title: Open questions
items: The steps mention yogurt, but no yogurt is listed. How much, or should "yogurt" come out of the step?
The bacon is listed but never used in the steps. Is it stirred in with the eggs?
